scope: All 81 English nonfoil futureshifted FUT cards; the 99 ordinary FUT cards are outside this frame study. Component-weighted structural match, not percentage-identical pixels. Fixed regions, frozen independent frame-only poses. Original wording matches on both sides, including reviewed Grandeur corrections. Rendered art is crop-only; no reference-assisted pixels enter scores. Incomplete art and credits remain unranked diagnostics. This local score map is not yet deployed to the review application.
method: Mean one-pixel edge F1 per component, then fixed weights over verified complete applicable components. Title10, mana8, type8, rules26, symbol8, stats8, frame20. Incomplete art8 and legal4 are diagnostic and excluded. Frozen scan alignment applied only to references.
